note: Set B is clean and accurate: all 12 claims are correctly bound, including the Region 2 (optimal TSR) range that Set A omits entirely, the 95 m/s maximum nominal tip speed, and the correctly paired DTU partial-load (torque, 0.05 Hz) and full-load (pitch, 0.03 Hz) pole parameters. Set A has many duplicates and several misbindings: it labels the 3–6.98 m/s wind-speed range as a 'minimum rotor speed operating range', assigns 0.03 Hz/70% to 'partial-load pole ... (pitch controller)' when partial-load poles are the torque controller, and states the 5 rpm minimum is 'to avoid the tower/monopile natural frequency' rather than 3P interference with it. Set A also contains fabricated/garbled quotes (e.g. 'pitch setting of 0° at (TSR)', 'full-load poles (pitch critical'). Set A does capture Region 2.5 negligible and rated wind speed, but its errors and redundancy outweigh that.
